> DIY MAKER RESOURCES

MATCHING RECORDS: 7

  • Ana-White:
    A long-standing public repository providing thousands of free, community-tested woodworking plans, cut lists, and step-by-step furniture building guides.
  • Build Something:
    A free project library sponsored by Kreg Tool offering downloadable woodworking plans, diagrams, and step-by-step tutorials for shop and home furniture.
  • Woodworking for Mere Mortals:
    An accessible, beginner-friendly woodworking platform created by Steve Ramsey focused on shop techniques, budget tool setups, and practical weekend projects.
  • Hackaday:
    An independent daily publication and community platform dedicated to reverse engineering, hardware modification, open-source electronics, and creative maker projects.
  • FreeSewing:
    An open-source platform that generates custom-fit sewing patterns tailored precisely to individual body measurements with zero ads or tracking.
  • Animated Knots by Grog:
    A comprehensive digital reference library providing clear step-by-step animations for tying hundreds of practical utility, boating, climbing, and working knots.
  • The Wood Database:
    A definitive reference guide providing detailed physical properties, workability, janka hardness ratings, and identification characteristics for hundreds of global wood species.
